text:
ana_product: Heads-up — pricing asks from two enterprise prospects. They want per-tenant token caps, opt-in longer data retention as a paid add-on, and contract language for guaranteed burst capacity. Need to decide how this maps to the roadmap and launch criteria.

sophia_engineering: Quick check: we currently have soft throttles + rate limiting middleware but no per-tenant hard quota enforcement.

raj_finance: Hard limits imply billing flows for overages or prepaid bundles. Also affects revenue recognition if we offer minimums.

mike_sales: Both prospects said they'll sign a 12mo if we can promise dedicated capacity + SLA and reasonable limits. If we can ship an "Enterprise Pack" in 6–8 weeks, we can close.

emma_support: Support impact: admin console to view/adjust tenant limits, alerting for quota breaches, and runbooks for overages.

lee_ceo: We should avoid shipping an incomplete solution to close deals. Prefer a gated rollout to signed customers only.

sophia_engineering: Proposed technical approach: (1) server-side quota table keyed by tenant, (2) enforcement middleware that returns 429 + structured error, (3) feature flag gating + canary to whitelisted tenants. Back-of-envelope effort: ~3 sprints across backend + console + billing hooks.

ana_product: oops typo above

ana_product: Launch criteria I'm proposing: 1) quota enforcement with observability (quota_exceeded metric), 2) billing overage flow and pro-rata handling tested, 3) admin console to set limits and view usage, 4) rollout policy + legal SLA/add-on terms drafted. Agree/disagree?

raj_finance: Add contract language: minimum committed spend, overage pricing at 150% of list rate, and 30-day notice for tier changes. Need legal to review.

mike_sales: Can we offer a "burst capacity" paid add-on that auto-scales for short windows? Prospect will pay for predictable compute during launches.

sophia_engineering: Example config we could expose to sales/legal for clarity:

```json
{
  "plan": "enterprise",
  "token_limit": 5000000,
  "burst": true,
  "overage_rate": 1.5
}
```

ops_bot: deploy-bot: feature flag created: `feature/tenant-quotas` (staging) :rocket:

ana_product: Action items: I'll draft the product spec doc + cost estimate + legal template. Assigning owners: @sophia_engineering for infra, @raj_finance for pricing/legal, @mike_sales for go-to-customer comms.

mike_sales: :thumbsup: I'll draft a one-pager for prospects and include transitional concessions.

emma_support: We'll need runbooks and a dashboard alert for 90% and 100% usage. Also add a customer-facing message for quota hits.

sophia_engineering: Agree on telemetry: counters for tokens_used, token_limit, quota_exceeded_count, and per-tenant latency impact. ETA: 6 weeks if we prioritize.

ana_product: Ok locking priority: P0 for Enterprise Pack (dedicated capacity + quotas + SLA) for next planning cycle. P2: self-serve per-tenant UI for SMB later. Flagging as dependent on billing hooks and legal sign-off.

lee_ceo: Sounds good. Keep me posted on any tradeoffs that affect cost or timeline.

mike_sales: Will follow up with the two prospects and push for signatures contingent on gated rollout.

ana_product: Thanks everyone — I'll open the spec PR and link here when ready.
